rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for saying that you like or favor one thing more than another.

example.english: I prefer drinking tea to drinking coffee.
example.traditional: 我比較鍾意飲茶，少啲飲咖啡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bei2 gaau3 zung1 ji3 jam2 caa4 siu2 di1 jam2 gaa3 fe1

rows.traditional: 鍾意 A 多過 B
rows.jyutping: zung1 ji3 A do1 gwo3 B
rows.note: Use this when you want to state the two alternatives explicitly and say that you like A more than B.

example.english: I prefer iced lemon tea to hot milk tea.
example.traditional: 我鍾意凍檸茶多過熱奶茶。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 dung3 ling4 caa4 do1 gwo3 jit6 naai5 caa4

rows.traditional: 寧願 A 都唔 B
rows.jyutping: ning4 jyun6 A dou1 m4 B
rows.note: Use this for choosing or being willing to do A rather than do B, especially with a stronger sense of 'would rather'.

example.english: I prefer walking home rather than taking a taxi.
example.traditional: 我寧願行返屋企，都唔搭的士。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ning4 jyun6 haang4 faan1 uk1 kei2 dou1 m4 daap3 dik1 si2

rows.note: Use this when the preference is expressed as an actual choice of A instead of B.

example.english: This time, I prefer the morning flight over the night flight.
example.traditional: 今次我揀早班機，唔揀夜機。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 ngo5 gaan2 zou2 baan1 gei1 m4 gaan2 je6 gei1
